feature_tests.verdict: PROMOTE TO GATE (descriptive separator), DEMOTE AS STANDALONE EDGE

Over-represented in fast-clean (0.195 vs 0.029 at 1s, std-diff +0.55). Test interaction with spread-vol gate; reject if bucket_13 stratified PF <= 0.467.

The failure mode is small wins (avg_win ~ avg_loss) not low hit rate alone. Build realized-vol-normalized win size, sub-second momentum continuation, micro-vol mean-reversion features to predict captured_exit_return magnitude, not just P_GREEN.
Well-calibrated; use as entry filter (require P_TAIL_LOSS < 0.20) combined with spread-vol gate.

hypotheses.rejection_gate: Tight gate (spread_to_realized_vol_max<=0.05 AND spread_to_micro_vol_max<=0.5) yields sealed executable captured_exit_pf < 1.0. ALREADY REJECTED: sealed PF 0.467 across ~2700 trades. Sufficiency fails; the feature is a discriminator, not an edge.
hypotheses.statement: Low spread_to_realized_vol and low spread_to_micro_vol are necessary conditions for fast winners but NOT sufficient for profitable execution net of spread.

hypotheses.rejection_gate: Reject unless a freshly drawn sealed-OOS slice reaches n>=200 with captured_exit_pf > 1.05 AND captured_exit_expectancy > 0 at the same per-trade spread assumption. Current n=20 is a tiny-sample/selection-bias victim; reject until replicated.
hypotheses.statement: A specific microstructure slice (USDCHF buy, new_york, volatility_expansion, m1_range_or_pullback, mfe_protection exit) carries genuine positive expectancy.

hypotheses.rejection_gate: Reject if, after re-gating per horizon, the standardized difference for spread_to_realized_vol does NOT fall monotonically 1s->10s, OR if any horizon's gated sealed PF crosses >1.0. Descriptive std-diff already falls -1.50->-0.89; expect no positive PF at any horizon (consistent with observed gated PF 0.46).
hypotheses.statement: The fast-winner edge (descriptive separation strength) decays monotonically as the holding horizon lengthens from 1s to 10s+.

hypotheses.rejection_gate: Reject if stratified PF for bucket_13 under the tight spread-vol gate is <= overall gated PF (0.467) with n_bucket >= 200 in sealed OOS.
hypotheses.statement: symbol_bucket_13 over-representation among fast-clean trades is a real cross-sectional effect, not noise, and improves gated PF.

hypotheses.rejection_gate: Reject if, on identical gated entry and n>=200/sealed-OOS slice, (mfe_protection PF - captured_exit_replay PF) <= 0. Positive only hinted by USDCHF n=20; requires validation.
hypotheses.statement: A fast MFE/tick-target exit recovers edge for the tight-spread-vol gated population better than captured_exit_replay.
